title: Analytical Candidate Admission + Evidence-Set Authority
authority_chain: Source -> Provenance -> Freshness -> Corroboration -> Quality / Anomaly -> Effective Observation -> Conflict / Escalation -> Evidence Lineage -> Observation Version -> Lifecycle / Retention -> Revocation / Rehabilitation -> Temporal Validity -> Instrument Binding -> Reasoning Context Composition -> Analytical Candidate -> Evidence Admission -> Candidate Evidence-Set Integrity

OBDATA081.name: Candidate evidence identity
OBDATA081.rule: Candidate and evidence identity are explicit and bound to reasoning target, symbol, instrument kind, observation version, and lineage.

OBDATA082.name: Evidence admission authority
OBDATA082.rule: Only evidence whose upstream composition state is explicitly ELIGIBLE and whose candidate target identity matches may be admitted.

OBDATA083.name: Duplicate / version / lineage contamination controls
OBDATA083.rule: Exact duplicates, multiple active versions of one observation, and duplicate lineage are blocked.

OBDATA084.name: Candidate evidence-set integrity
OBDATA084.rule: The candidate set independently verifies upstream eligibility, target consistency, version consistency, exact uniqueness, and lineage uniqueness.
